episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Hyun-jin and Tae-hyung are at odds from the moment they meet, only to discover that they will soon be in-laws.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: The in-laws who have been at odds are forced to live together with their orphaned nephew, Woo-joo.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: As they navigate caring for Woo-joo, Tae-hyung makes an irresistible proposition to Hyun-jin and proposes cohabitating for a month.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: As Hyun-jin and Tae-hyung's relationship deepens, Hyun-jin hides their living arrangement from her first love, Yoon-seong.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: As Yoon-seong discovers Hyun-jin's secret, Tae-hyung learns that Yoon-seong was her first love.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Tae-hyung gets assigned to work with Hyun-jin and Yoon-seong, while Hyun-jin learns of Tae-hyung's true feelings.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Tae-hyung is shaken by the sudden appearance of his estranged father. Meanwhile, Hyun-jin struggles at work.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Hyun-jin finds herself torn between Yoon-seong and Tae-hyung.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Having learned the truth about his past, Tae-hyung decides to leave Hyun-jin and Woo-joo for their safety.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: As Hyun-jin grows closer to Yoon-seong, Tae-hyung keeps his distance and decides to move abroad.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: Hyun-jin reunites with Tae-hyung after realizing her feelings for him, but their day out is disrupted when Woo-joo goes missing.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: As Woo-joo's guardianship hearing approaches, an unexpected incident threatens to tear the family apart.
